name: Card Atlas
description: Browse the community's character cards without leaving the app: search six hubs — Character Tavern, RisuRealm, Chub, Wyvern, AI Character Cards, CharaVault — with real cover art, page through the results, filter by tags, read a card properly, and add it straight to your library — art and all, provenance-stamped, dedupe-aware.
author: Orbweaver
